findings.evidence: Groupoid.lean:61-71 defines `source_def`, `target_def`, `identity_def` and `inversion_hom` with `(rfl)`. The diff adds no such lemma for any new def, and its proofs run `simp [first, second, composition, initialPair, last, suffix, ...]`.
findings.fix: Add `first_def`, `second_def`, `composition_def`, `initialPair_def`, `last_def` and `suffix_def`, each proved by `(rfl)`, following `source_def`/`target_def`/`identity_def` in Groupoid.lean. Use them in the proofs instead of unfolding the definitions.
findings.issue: `first`, `second`, `composition`, `initialPair`, `last` and `suffix` (lines 41, 45, 59, 192, 196, 207) are unexposed `def`s with no `*_def` lemma. Downstream code cannot unfold them and so cannot relate them to `algebraMap`, `ChangeRing.map rightUnit`, `coproduct`, etc. The proofs here only work because they unfold the bodies inside this file.

findings.evidence: `first_target` is `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]` with proof `isPullback_first_second.w`. The `composePrefix` definition passes `(by simpa using isPullback_initialPair_last.w)`. `composition_assoc` has no attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem initialPair_second_target : initialPair ≫ second ≫ target = last ≫ source := isPullback_initialPair_last.w` (adjusting associativity as needed), and mark `composition_assoc` with `@[reassoc]`.
findings.issue: The commuting square of `isPullback_initialPair_last` is never stated as a lemma, unlike `first_target` for pairs. The PR itself needs `simpa using isPullback_initialPair_last.w` to build `composePrefix`. `composition_assoc` (line 252) also lacks `@[reassoc]`, which every other law in the file has.

summary: The new scheme-level morphisms have no `*_def` characterization lemmas, unlike the `source_def`/`target_def`/`identity_def` pattern in Groupoid.lean, so downstream code cannot connect them to the Hopf-algebroid ring maps. The triple-level commuting square also has no simp/reassoc lemma like `first_target`, and `composition_assoc` lacks `@[reassoc]`.
